fields.executor: poller_job:... or none. Not an agent name.
fields.agent_may_invoke: false means an agent must not start this order
fields.allowed_actions: capability ids. The broker still applies the capability registry.
fields.max_attempts: cap for the executor that already owns recovery
fields.requires_operator: human gate for the executor. False does not mean an agent may run it.
fields.security_review: true when Carly's later check is required before an unlock
fields.on_block: what the executor does after the cap
fields.verification: checks that must pass after recovery. process_alive is a process scan.
fields.family: optional. machine | development. Absent means machine for orders already in this directory.
fields.request_id: optional. Interaction request that produced a development order. Machine orders omit it.
